reviews.text: Been coming here before it has always been great. Depends on the doctors you get. Personally, Dr. Diller, Dr. Simmons and Dr. Zhu have always been great and amazing dealing with my extremely aggressive cat. I’d just be very well informed about your pets health prior to your vet visits that way it’ll make the process easier and you know what exactly your pet needs.
Took my puppy to Bond....great experience....definitely will bring him back ....

Took my very sick cat on the 18th of august as a follow up to initial appointment at LIC office in June. At first i was happy this location seemed better than the LIC location because they looked at the same test results from the prev appointment and were able to give me way more information. They explained the recommending testing and treatment to me, all was well. I paid to get bloodwork done and they said it would take a few days to a week for them to call me with results. 2 weeks later I call to check in, they said there is a note for the doctor to get back to me with results but no doctor ever did. Now they will leave an urgent note for the same. Why wasnt it already urgent?
Keep in mind my cat is very sick. The vet was telling me at my appointment that i also need an ultrasound asap bc technically my cats condition could worsen any day. So its that urgent, but no follow up on the blood work results?
If i hadnt followed up who knows if they ever would have gotten back to me. Feels like they just wanted my money and didnt care about my cat :(
Update: its now been another week since i last called, and nobody called me with my results. I called them again today and again they say someone will call me back. We will see. Its almost been a month since my appointment. So upset will definitely not be back.
Dr. Simmons and Mira were excellent. They were so helpful and made sure my cat was taken care of. I would definitely come back.

You can tell when someone is a true animal lover versus someone just playing the part, and Dr. Ruby Ng is as real as it gets.
Beyond the incredible bedside manner, the entire clinic is top-tier. The staff is prompt, highly professional, and seamless to work with. The facility itself is beautiful, spotless, and equipped with tech to handle your pet needs.
The veterinarian my pets saw previously was also very nice, so I don’t say this lightly — but I genuinely prefer Bond Vet. The combination of excellent care, professionalism, and, most importantly, people who clearly love animals makes a real difference.
They are very good in resolving the issues for my dog, and it is a very clean vet. I started coming here and have not stopped since, they have good service, and the doc was very respectful and nice!

We bring our pets to bond vet for emergency care, and are transitioning to them as our permanent vet. Staff is always extremely kind, caring, and knowledgeable. Care is more affordable than some other clinics.

Reporting this place to BBB. Reception staff (person answered the phone to confirm appointment on the day) nasty and not honoring appointments made because doctors get double booked, and then they gaslight us and told us to figure something else out. By the time we got there it turned out they used a different doctor, and the person who picked up the phone is prone to arguing rather than resolving the issue. Avoid this place.

Just want to thank Dr. Diller and Ally for taking care of my pup Chanel, she always gets a little nervous when it comes to getting a check up but they were great and took good care of her. Book your next apt here if you want the best care for your doggo!
Everyone was super sweet to my doggy! Thanks a bunch!
Super easy and knowledgeable! They were great at answering our many questions about our new cat!

Bond Vet Astoria may not be the cheapest vet in town, but they will always be worth the cost to me. I have brought my two beloved cats here for both annual visits and surgical procedures, and have never had anything less than a fantastic experience.

The vets and vet techs are so kind and truly love animals, and this is evident at every step of the process. Even when my older cat had a poor recovery after his surgery, the Bond Vet team did a stellar job at addressing his issues and getting him comfortable and back to normal as soon as possible.

I would recommend Bond Vet Astoria to anyone looking for top-quality, compassionate care for their pets, as I truly believe my boys are in great hands with the staff here.

I did not have a good experience with this clinic. It felt like they wanted to order as many tests as possible, but when it came time to provide the results, it took more than a month. I paid for the consultation and all the tests, and while I was worried about my dog’s health, I felt like there was very little communication.
I’m also unable to order my dog’s prescription kidney food from online retailers because they decline the authorization and tell me I need another appointment. The same thing happens with her medications, they won’t authorize refills without another visit, even though those appointments usually lead to more testing, and then the results are not communicated in a timely manner.
Overall, I was very disappointed with the experience. I’m currently waiting for them to return my phone call, and I hope they address these concerns.

Really disappointed with my experience at Bond Vet. The last time I brought Logan in, I had to return two days later because of an allergic reaction. Now, two days after his neuter, he's dealing with scrotal swelling. I know complications can happen, but this has been frustrating. Same day charge is almost 300$. God!!!

The experience of bond vet feels closer to an Apple Store where you’re there to upgrade the firmware on an iPad more than getting healthcare for an animal you love.

We used to justify the fact that we rarely had an appointment where they didn’t find a way to recommend treatments for 500-700 dollars because the office was nice, because it was convenient, because there weren’t many options in the neighborhood. But over the last year it's grown extremely cold for a place we've spent countless thousands of dollars over the years.

A few examples of the quality of service you can expect, when our last dog passed, a dog that had been coming to bond for years. They continuously sent a cutesy promo texts to us trying to drum up business in the hot summer months. Because it’s impossible to actually call the office we had to come into the office to ask to stop and remind them we lost our dog very recently but they still continued to send them. I know that’s not big but it shows the lack of human touch, the lack of compassion. That’s bond. It’s about revenue, it’s about marketing, it’s about get people in get people out, it’s about if I can’t invoice you for this I’m not wasting my time speaking to you.

With our new puppy we made the mistake of bringing him back to Bond because again it’s convenient. Admittedly he’s a very high energy dog who craves attention, he whines, he wiggles, he jumps, he can’t sit still. He’s a Boxer puppy. But he’s super food motivated so you can get him to do anything for a treat, and once he gets to know you he chills out. But investing time and effort, that’s not Bond.

The vet demanded he be on two different sedatives so it was easier to examine him. The next appointment they texted twice that day to remind us he can’t come in without the drugs then again asked us as we came in the doors to make sure.

It's not the fact that we were asked to drug our dog to the point of him being a compliant statue to allow you to spend the least amount of time possible in an appointment. It's the fact that you did it with zero delicacy and showed that your company cares a big fat zero for the humans and animals that come in your doors.

Everyone from the staff in front to the techs to the vets themselves seem more concerned with turning appointments than showing patience and taking the time to get to know a young dog and make the experience comfortable for everyone. Their default response is what’s the path of least resistance to get through this as fast as possible get to the invoice and bring in the next sucker to bleed dry.

Never again.

İ went there with my cat 1 months ago ago for yearly check up and vaccines and now its been a week and half that i am dealing with fungus,
İ had same environment for cat for always and only place she been token is Bond vet for a quick checkup.

Hello Leo,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us and for giving us a 4-star rating. We’re glad to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Astoria. 

We look forward to seeing you and your furry friend again soon!

Best regards,
The Bond Vet - Astoria Team

Last night I went to Bond hoping I was going to be leaving with my cat, but knowing I likely was not. I want to start by saying that the girls at the desk were wonderful and the techs were wonderful. The vet I saw, Dr. Keith Lewy was not. The visit was traumatic as it was and he made it significantly more. My appointment was at 7pm and I know they were going to be closing soon but he rushed my entire process and rushed me to euthanize my cat and it was horrible. As someone who has had animals their entire life I know how euthanasia works. I usually have the vet come to my home, but sadly my baby was not going to make it until Thursday when the vet was scheduled to come so I had to take her to Bond. My cat was so stressed out and Dr. Lewy rushed me to do the sedative once they put the catheter in and then rushed me once they sedated her to give the final injection. He kept telling me that the sedative was going to wear off and she was going to wake up. I’ve never had a vet tell me that and it was truly heartbreaking to feel like I couldn’t even have time to spend with my cat while she was still alive. Once she had passed he then rushed to take her so I have this immense guilt about even taking her there. It will forever be engrained in my head and heart how terrible our final moments together were. It didn’t have to be that way. I didn’t get the time that I wanted with my cat. Before I even left the office Dr. Lewy was out the door so it showed me that he was clearly in a rush to get me out so he could leave. When you’re going through something so heartbreaking that’s not the experience you want to have. I have spent thousands of dollars at Bond in the last year between my two cats and I will not be returning once I pick up my cat’s ashes. I rarely leave negative reviews, but I don’t want another pet owner to ever have to feel the way I do right now. My heart is broken and understandably, but the guilt I feel for my cat’s final moments doesn’t have to and shouldn’t be my burden.
